text: What if every salary on Earth became public overnight?
A new app. Type in any name, see what they earn. Your whole office is on it before breakfast.
You find out the guy next to you earns four hundred more. Same job. He started after you.
The HR inbox gets three hundred emails in one hour. The coffee machine becomes a negotiation table.
Someone looks up the boss. The room goes very quiet.
Raises everywhere. Companies suddenly find money they said they didn't have.
Your mom asks how much you make. For the first time, you can't change the subject.
And part of this is already coming. An EU law says companies must tell you the salary range before the job interview. Germany is late. It's expected in twenty twenty seven.
Would you want your salary public? Tell me in the comments.
